name: Hicks
source:
Like Keane, he is one of the initial members of the Black Dog Mercenaries. Although his appearance and behavior are aloof and frivolous, on the battlefield he is a skilled leader who is the first to charge into the enemy lines.

In peacetime, he often drinks and plays with women in bars.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/spin.html]official site[/url]]
